2609.10745.title: Think Before You Link: Rarity, Reasoning, and Retrieval in Multilingual Entity Linking
2609.10745.paper_summary: Multimodal entity linking grounds entity mentions in text and images to knowledge-base entries. These systems degrade on rare entities, but prior work measures rarity primarily through popularity-based metrics such as pageviews. We broaden this view using knowledge-graph structural metrics that capture how well an entity is documented and connected. These metrics identify many rare entities that popularity metrics miss. Across the resulting rare-entity slices, state-of-the-art accuracy drops by 15.4-39.9%, showing that different rarity definitions expose different failure modes. To address these failures, we introduce a simple, training-free framework in which a reasoning-capable vision-language model iteratively searches and reasons over Wikipedia, gathering evidence dynamically. Controlled experiments show that reasoning and retrieval are complementary. Reasoning alone does not significantly improve accuracy on rare entities. Retrieval without reasoning improves rare-entity accuracy but can hurt overall accuracy. Their combination performs best. On MERLIN, a multilingual multimodal entity linking benchmark over five languages (Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Tamil, Vietnamese), our best system improves over the state of the art by 6.9% overall and by up to 23.3% on rare-entity slices. We release MERLIN-Rare, rare-entity test slices for targeted evaluation, with our framework.
2609.10745.paper_summary_zh: 多模態實體連結將文本和圖像中的實體提及與知識庫條目相連結。這些系統在稀有實體上表現不佳，但先前的研究主要通過基於流行度的指標（如頁面瀏覽量）來衡量稀有性。我們擴展了這一觀點，使用知識圖譜結構指標來捕捉實體的文檔記錄和連接程度。這些指標識別出許多流行度指標所忽略的稀有實體。在所得到的稀有實體片段中，最先進的準確率下降了15.4-39.9%，顯示出不同的稀有性定義揭示了不同的失敗模式。為了解決這些失敗，我們引入了一個簡單的無需訓練的框架，其中一個具有推理能力的視覺-語言模型迭代地搜索和推理維基百科，動態收集證據。受控實驗表明，推理和檢索是互補的。僅僅依賴推理並未顯著提高稀有實體的準確性。沒有推理的檢索提高了稀有實體的準確性，但可能會損害整體準確性。它們的組合表現最佳。在MERLIN上，這是一個涵蓋五種語言（印地語、印尼語、日語、泰米爾語、越南語）的多語言多模態實體連結基準，我們的最佳系統整體上提高了6.9%的表現，並在稀有實體片段上提高了最多23.3%。我們發布了MERLIN-Rare，針對性評估的稀有實體測試片段，並附上我們的框架。
